parse.title: The Colosseum
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-Colosseum.png}} {{E|The Colosseum}} is an [[Event]] found exclusively in [[Act 2]]. It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}. It only appears after the guaranteed [[Map Locations#Treasure Room|Treasure Room]] on the 6th floor of the City. ==Options== {{Frame|Fight}} * The player enters a fight with a {{M|Blue Slaver}} and {{M|Red Slaver}}. This fight gives no rewards.
After the fight ends, a choice has to be made: {{Frame|COWARDICE}} Escape.

{{Frame|VICTORY}} A powerful fight with many rewards. * The player enters a fight with {{M|Taskmaster}} and {{M|Gremlin Nob}}. * The rewards are 100 [[Gold]], 1 {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} [[Relic]], 1 {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Uncommon|Uncommon}} [[Relic]], a card reward, and sometimes a [[Potion]].
==Dialogue==
{{TS||shake|Thwack!!!}}
..
......
...
{{TS||up|You were knocked unconscious...}}


{{Frame|Continue}}

{{TS||up|Groggy}} and with a {{TS||shake|throbbing}} head, you awaken to find yourself thrown in the center of a massive stadium with an overflowing audience of {{TS|blue||Slavers,}} {{TS|purple||Cultists,}} and other denizens of the City!
An armored giant with a {{TS|gold||golden crown}} bellows at you from atop,
{{TS||shake|"WE NOW BEGIN THE 4200TH COMBAT!!!!"}}
A gate on the opposite side opens...
{{Frame|Fight}}
(The player enters combat with a {{M|Blue Slaver}} and {{M|Red Slaver}}. After ending the fight, more dialogue is presented.)

{{TS||shake|"WELL DONE, WEAKLING!"}}
The giant mock claps whilst he riles up the crowd with exaggerated gestures.
{{TS|gold|up|Gold}} {{TS||up|and}} {{TS|gold|up|confetti}} {{TS||up|shower you!}}
{{TS||shake|"TIME FOR THE REAL CHALLENGE!!"}}

The last battle left a small hole in the Colosseum's wall, you can easily escape through there while everyone is distracted.
Do you stay and fight?
{{Frame|COWARDICE}}
(No dialogue)
{{Frame|VICTORY}}
(No dialogue, the player enters combat with {{M|Taskmaster}} and {{M|Gremlin Nob}})
==Notes== Some mechanics behave strangely during the two fights in this event due to their atypical nature: * {{Frame|Fight}} is treated as a normal combat. ** {{P|Smoke Bomb}} can be used to escape the fight and the player will still be prompted to choose either {{Frame|COWARDICE}} or {{Frame|VICTORY}} afterwards as normal. ** The game still rolls to drop a [[Potion]], but never presents the player with it even if a [[Potion]] would be dropped. This means it is impossible to know if the [[Potions#Sources|potion chance]] has increased or decreased, and this uncertainty will persist until the [[Potions#Sources|potion chance]] resets at start of the next act. ** While it has no combat rewards and transitions to the next dialogue of the event very quickly, end-of-combat effects like {{R|Burning Blood}} and {{C|Self Repair}} will still trigger. * {{Frame|VICTORY}} is treated as an [[Elite]] combat for ''most'' effects. ** {{R|Preserved Insect}}, {{R|Sling of Courage}}, and {{R|Slaver's Collar}} will all trigger their effects as expected. ** The only exception is {{R|Black Star}}, which has no effect on the [[Relics]] dropped as rewards. This combat will ''always'' drop exactly 1 {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} [[Relic]] and 1 {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Uncommon|Uncommon}} [[Relic]]. ==Trivia== * The "armored giant with a {{TS|gold||golden crown}}" is likely {{M|The Champ}}. ==Update History== * '''Patch V1.1: The Dealer''' ** Colosseum event now appears only at the top half of Act 2. * '''Slay the Spire 1.0: Farewell Early Access''' ** Colossuem Nob fight ordering swapped so that the Nob can apply Vulnerable. * '''Weekly Patch 56: The Collector''' ** Colosseum event's second fight is now a Gremlin Nob + Taskmaster (rather than 2 Gremlin Nobs) * '''Weekly Patch 42: Reboot''' ** Orb VFX no longer render in the background of the Colosseum event. * '''Weekly Patch 41: Chill''' ** Colosseum Nobs no longer play double music. ** Fixed bug causing block to maintain between colosseum combats. ** Fixed Smoke Bomb and Colosseum bug that caused the player to go invisible. ** Killing a Colosseum Nob no longer causes the music to stop. * '''Weekly Patch 39: We Meet Again!''' ** Added City Event: The Colosseum. {{EventNav}} [[Category:Events]]
